title: Wanesong
body: ![LogoBanner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/970221e721551c86dfe09c3412cb63eb993ecc2c_0.webp) # Wanesong ![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/wanesong?style=for-the-badge) ![Modrinth Game Versions](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/game-versions/wanesong?style=for-the-badge) > This resource pack utilizes the Optifine format to replace Minecraft's vanilla sky. Variations of the sky are displayed at different times of the day (Sunrise, Daytime, Sunset, Night, and Weather). There is also a separate sky for the end dimension. ## Requirements > This pack can be used with **one** of these options: > - Skyboxify > - Optifine > - Nuit w/ Nuit Interop > **Recommended: Turn off Sun & Moon** [![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/M4M61V7YTQ) ### Issue? Let me know on Discord!
